name: Sight (Vision / Fog of War)
description: Standard vision that dispels Fog of War over a radius around units, structures and wards (champions 1350, minions 1200, wards 900, Farsight Wards 500); enemy units become visible when their center enters the radius, and terrain/brush block line of sight.

name: Stealth (umbrella)
description: Positive effects that temporarily conceal a unit from enemy sight regardless of Fog of War; divided into Camouflage, Invisibility and Stealthed traps, broken by attacking/casting and countered by true sight.

name: Camouflage
description: Stealth category that conceals the unit only while no enemy champion is within its detection radius with direct line of sight; the smallest detection radius wins among multiple sources, and invisibility overrides camouflage.

name: Invisibility
description: Stealth category that fully conceals the unit until it attacks or casts; only true sight (e.g. turrets, Vision/Control Wards, Mark) reveals it.

name: Stealthed Trap
description: Deployable traps and wards that are stealthed and only revealed by true-sight sources such as Control Wards, Sweeper Drones or Umbral Glaive's Blackout.

name: True Sight
description: A form of sight that reveals stealthed units, wards and traps and always includes standard sight; granted by turrets, Control Wards, Oracle Lens, Umbral Glaive, Scryer's Bloom and select abilities/summoner spells.

name: Nearsight
description: Debuff that shrinks the victim's sight radius, removing allied ward vision (including wards the victim placed), blocking true sight and unobstructed vision, and preventing detection of stealthed wards/traps.

name: Obscured Vision
description: Detection that exposes a hidden unit's position via silhouette, movement or VFX without making it visible or targetable; unaffected by nearsight.

name: Unobstructed Vision
description: A type of sight that passes through terrain so the unit sees beyond its normal sight radius; cannot see into brush from outside and is entirely negated by nearsight.

name: Attacker Reveal (Fog of War)
description: Using a unit-targeted spell or basic attack from inside Fog of War reveals a 300-unit radius around the attacker to the enemy team for 2 seconds after the attack completes.

name: Ward (Deployable Vision Unit)
keywords: distinguished order of ward longevity and health
description: A deployable unit that removes Fog of War over a radius: Stealth/Totem Wards are stealthed with 900 sight and 3 HP, Control Wards are visible with 4 HP and reveal+disable, Farsight Wards have 500 sight, and Fiddlesticks' Effigy counts as a ward.

name: Ward Placement Limit
description: A player can have at most 3 Stealth/Totem Wards (shared pool) and 1 Control Ward placed at a time; placing beyond the limit replaces the oldest ward of that type, and Zombie Wards do not count toward the limit.

name: Ward Stealth Fade-in
description: Newly placed Stealth/Totem Wards are visible for 1-2 seconds (Totem 2s, Stealth 1s) before becoming stealthed; targeting an allied ward with Teleport or unit-targeted abilities exposes it (Teleport refreshes the exposure during its channel).

name: Ward Disabling
description: Control Wards, Sweeper Drones and Umbral Glaive's Blackout disable enemy wards (and reveal stealthed traps), removing their vision entirely; disabled wards grant no sight and Scryer's Bloom gives true sight of wards hit for 12s.

name: Ward Destruction & Bounty
description: Wards have fixed health (3 for Stealth/Totem, 4 for Control/Vision), take exactly 1 damage per basic attack regardless of damage, regenerate out of combat, and grant gold on destruction (5g; historically 10-30g with XP that was removed in V14.19); revealer and killer both earn the bounty when vision was provided.

name: Ward Rubble
description: Wards that are destroyed, expire or are replaced leave behind rubble for 5 minutes (fading over time) that can reveal the enemy's warding habits.

name: Ward Timer
description: Pinging or attacking an enemy ward within 10 seconds of placement shows an accurate expiry timer for that ward, and allied wards appear withered on the minimap once a third of their duration remains.

name: Vision Score
description: Post-game stat estimating vision influence (~1 point per minute of ward lifetime provided or denied, permanent wards worth 1.5 min denied) with modifiers for staleness (-50%), redundancy (-25% to -75%), safety and pointlessness (-100%), plus points from vision-only abilities and effects like Scryer's Bloom.

name: Zombie Ward
description: Domination rune (removed V25.S1.1) that spawned a friendly visible ward (1100 sight, 1 HP, 120s, outside the ward limit, 1g bounty) where an enemy ward was destroyed with the user's kill or vision assist.

name: Deep Ward
description: Domination rune that empowers Stealth/Totem Wards placed in the enemy jungle (and river at level 9) with +1 bonus health and extended duration (+30-45s Stealth, +30-120s Totem).

name: Starting Gold
description: The gold every champion begins a match with, fixed by map/game mode: 500 on Summoner's Rift, 1400 on Howling Abyss.

name: Passive Gold Generation
description: Gold earned without player action at a per-10-seconds rate ticked every 0.5s after a start delay (20.4/10s at 1:05 on Summoner's Rift, 60/10s at 1:00 on Howling Abyss); increasable by gold income items.

name: Kill Gold Bounty
description: Gold awarded to the killer for slaying units (champions, minions, monsters, wards, inhibitors); champion kills uniquely generate additional assist gold, and some units dispense global or local bounties shared with the team.

name: Assist Bounty
description: Extra gold generated on assisted champion kills, split equally among assisters at half the kill bounty (capped at 50% of the base bounty) with a 50%-to-100% early-game ramp from 0:55 to 2:55.

name: Champion Bounty (Shut Down)
description: Champion kill reward that scales with performance: base bounty 300g until level 6 then +10g/level (cap 420g), accruing 1 bounty per 3g earned from kills/assists and 1 per 20g from minion/monster/support gold (1:7 while behind), depreciating 1 per 3.5g distributed on death, with Shut Down bounties (beyond base+100) fully removed and extended bounties (beyond base+700) rolling over respawns.

name: First Blood
description: The first champion kill of the match grants the killer 100 bonus gold on top of the slain champion's normal bounty.

name: Global & Local Bounties
description: Some units (all turrets, certain epic monsters) dispense bounties shared equally team-wide regardless of range/death (global) or among nearby living allies (local); Turret Plating splits gold among nearby champions, with the destroyer's share guaranteed regardless of range.

name: Gold Income Items (Support Quest)
description: Support economy items (World Atlas into Runic Compass) generate bonus gold through passive income plus charges earned by minion sharing near an ally or poking enemy champions, upgrading after completing a 400g quest per tier.

name: Item Sellback
description: Most items sell to the shop for 70% of their total cost; consumables, gold-generating items, Doran's items, Dark Seal and Guardian Angel sell for only 40%, and some items (jungle/support quest items, elixirs) cannot be sold at all.

name: Experience Bounty
description: XP dispensed when units die: dying champions to allies within 1600 units (kill/assist credit guarantees the share), minions within 1500 units, monsters to their killer exclusively (epic monsters locally, Baron globally), all split equally among eligible champions.

name: Solo & Shared Experience
description: Yield modifiers for minion-type bounties: one champion receives 100% of the bounty, while multiple champions generate ~130% total split equally (65% each for two, 43.3% for three, down to 21.7% for six).

name: Comeback Experience
description: XP modifiers from level difference: lower-level champions earn more XP (up to +200% from minions 6 levels higher, +20% per level beyond 1.0 for champion kills) while higher-level earners are penalized up to -60%.

name: Jungle Experience Rules
description: Jungle item users always earn bonus XP from large monsters and +50 XP per level of disadvantage when behind the average level, but suffer reduced XP from minion kills (70%-to-0 penalty over 20 minutes, plus a 50% Monster Hunter cut when minion gold exceeds 40% of monster gold, removed at 14 min).

name: Leveling & Level Cap
description: XP thresholds grant levels (280 XP to level 2, +100 each level to 1880 at 18); each level-up automatically awards stat growth and a skill point, with the default cap 18 raised to 20 by the Top Lane Role Quest (30 in URF, 41 in Arena).
